outline: This course will give a student with a basic background and understanding of general health and safety practices and the control measures required to reduce risks in the workplace.
schedule:
1st week : Introduction to laboratory safety and health (實驗室安全衛生概論)
2nd week: Hazard Communication and MSDS (危害通識與MSDS)
3rd week : Fire and Explosion (火災爆炸)
4th week : Chemical Hazards (化學性危害)
5th week : Biological Hazards (生物性危害)
6th week : Chemical Reaction Hazards (化學反應危害)
7th week : Electrical Safety (電氣安全)
8th week : Respiratory Protection (呼吸防護)
9th week : Noise Hazard (噪音危害)
10th week: Personal Protective Equipment (個人防護具)
11th week: Confined Space Safety
12th week: Study Safety Cases in Industrial Processes
13th week: Review
14th week: Group Presentation
15th week: Group Presentation
16th week: Group Presentation
17th week: Group Presentation
18th week: Final exam
assessment:
Group presentation	        				35 %
Final Exam 							45 %
Classroom participants (Q&A)	                20 %
